what_this_is: The committed measurement contract for the PetTripFinder site (PTF-MEASUREMENT-001). Read by scripts/pettripfinder/measurement.py at build time. While enabled is false, generation emits NO provider script, NO page_view, NO build_id markup and the composed bundle hash does not move. Enabling is its own release: set enabled true, name a cookieless provider of kind beacon_script, add its host to script-src/connect-src in deploy/netlify/headers.*, rebuild, re-stamp the global deployment manifest, and authorize THAT bundle hash. No vendor is configured here.
